name: Vibe-Edge
desc: An end-to-end system I built from scratch to turn trading ideas into trades: an 8-layer flow from data to trade lists, with a fixed statistical validation engine that blocks overfitting and look-ahead bias.

name: FinCLI
desc: The data layer of Vibe-Edge: a Taiwan market data CLI that fetches raw data from TWSE, TPEx, MOPS, TEJ, and more, with daily incremental updates.

name: AI Financial Agent
desc: A financial AI Agent that combines multiple data sources for investment research and decisions.

name: AI Hedge Fund
desc: A Multi-Agent system that simulates fund managers working together on portfolio and trading decisions.

name: Dexter
desc: An autonomous financial research Agent that collects information and writes reports.

name: OpenStrategy
desc: An open quant trading strategy framework with backtesting and parameter optimization.

name: Barra Multifactor Model
desc: A Barra multifactor model for risk analysis and portfolio factor decomposition.

name: PyQt Stock Backtesting
desc: A PyQt GUI backtesting tool with the Yahoo API and multiple strategies.

name: Transformer
desc: A PyTorch implementation of the Transformer from "Attention Is All You Need".

name: EDGAR Crawler
desc: An SEC filing crawler that extracts selected sections into structured JSON.
